summary.caption_note: RISE is run at its published budget (4000); no smaller budget reached a median rank correlation of 0.95 with it. KernelSHAP is run at 256 coalitions rather than the published 2080: on 14 records of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct its 16-group ranking has a median Spearman correlation of 0.96 with the published budget's, and its agreement with measured group patching (zero replacement) is 0.301 against 0.285. Absent patches take the per-picture mean state; KernelSHAP's players are the 16 patch groups.
